address: GF, Commercial Bay, 7 Queen Street, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: Following on from the success of the original Queenstown restaurant, this second branch continues the theme of showcasing the best local produce by putting a spin on classic recipes, with the addition of some Mediterranean influences. Meats like lamb shoulder are a speciality and it’s worth adding the fantastic duck-fat roast potatoes to any order – if you do, then consider trying on those pants in the next-door boutique after, rather than before, your lunch. The wooden floors and sheepskin on the chairs add plenty of warmth to the bright, well-run room.
